branded.why: The malted chocolate drink of Southeast Asia and Australia, drunk daily across the region.

about.text: Malted chocolate drink powder created by Thomas Mayne at Nestlé in Australia in 1934, made of malted barley, milk powder, cocoa and sugar.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Stirred into hot or cold milk, or sprinkled on top; in Southeast Asia it is sometimes served iced
Made at Nestlé's Jurong factory; Milo ais (iced) and Milo peng are popular, and Milo Dinosaur, with extra powder on top, is a Malaysian kopitiam drink
